第19章 你这人不怎么耐打呀（第1页）
“哎呀呀，我们的奇葩长老反应倒是挺快嘛！”
一道笑声传来，只见一行三人从不远处一棵大树后走出。
为首的，赫然正是南山宗八长老，邱略！
看着对方手中的长弓，张云眼神眯起。
“尾随？若非有一刻钟限制，本长老早就把你解决了！”
邱略冷哼道：“你也不看看自己是什么货色，敢跟本长老打赌比成绩？本长老现在就让你直接丧失获得成绩的能力！”
说着掏出一根羽箭搭在弓上，灵气弥漫，对准张云‘咻’的就是一箭射来。
张云这回有预警，第一时间推开身边徐鸣二人，自己朝一侧躲闪开。
缭绕着灵气的羽箭落在地上，气劲能量爆发，竟是直接让地面炸开了一道小坑。
这一箭要是落在身上，他不死也得半残！
“躲得倒挺快，但你还能继续躲开本长老的下一箭吗？”
邱略见状哼了声，手上已是又取出一根羽箭搭在弓上。
这时徐鸣与吴小胖也反应过来，纷纷取出武器。
两个小小炼气期，他随便就能斩杀。不过身为长老，他也有他的傲气，还不屑于对弟子出手。
当即看了眼身后，嘱咐了句：“留个活口，废了就行！”
在他身后的两位弟子应声，冷笑迎向徐鸣二人，如同看着两头待宰的羔羊。
一个筑基期修为长老的弟子能有什么实力？最重要是徐鸣和吴小胖模样都很青涩，年纪顶多也就十七八岁，实力能有个炼气三四重在他们看来就顶天了。

他们可是跟着邱略修炼了超过五年，境界早已达至炼气期八重。
“白师弟，那个胖子交给你，我来废了这小白脸！”
两位弟子说着，分别迎向徐鸣二人。
邱略见状也是一脸放心，手中之弓搭起羽箭再次指向张云，嘿笑道：“放心吧，奇葩长老，本长老会留你一条狗命的。毕竟还得等你出去后，把赌注还上！”
然而这一箭却是再次被躲开，落中地面绽起一道小坑。
邱略并未在意，看着脚步凌乱的张云，嘴角勾着一抹玩弄的冷笑，又一箭射出。
身为一位擅使弓的修士，他很享受看着敌人如猎物般，被他射得狼狈四处躲闪。
张云再次躲开，那脚步看起来更凌乱了。
邱略嘴角的玩弄愈发浓郁，继续搭弓射箭。
一箭又一箭，看着不断狼狈躲闪的张云，邱略冷笑：“差不多该让你见见血了！”
说着他眼神一凝，羽箭上灵气爆发射出，这一箭的速度明显比先前任何一箭都要更快。
正当他期待着张云身上血花绽放时，却发现前一秒脚步凌乱的张云，这一秒那脚下猛地一绷直，竟是迈出了一道玄妙步伐，完美躲开了这凌厉一箭。

Chapter 19 You are not very durable (Page 1)
"Oh my, our strange elder reacts very quickly!"
A burst of laughter came, and a group of three people was seen walking out from behind a big tree not far away.
The leader was surprisingly none other than the eighth elder of the Nanshan Sect, Qiu Lue!
Looking at the long bow in the opponent's hand, Zhang Yun narrowed his eyes.
"Following? If it weren't for the quarter-hour limit, this elder would have dealt with you long ago!"
Qiu Lue snorted coldly: "You don't know what kind of thing you are, how dare you make a bet with me to compare your grades? This elder will make you lose your ability to get grades right now!"
As he spoke, he took out an arrow and put it on the bow, filled with spiritual energy, and aimed at Zhang Yun and shot an arrow.
Zhang Yun had a warning this time and immediately pushed Xu Ming and the two around him away, dodging to one side.
The feather arrow surrounded by aura fell to the ground, and the energy exploded, causing a small pit to explode in the ground.
If this arrow lands on him, he will be half disabled even if he is not dead!
"You dodged pretty quickly, but can you still dodge my elder's next arrow?"
Qiu Lue snorted when he saw this, and took out another feather arrow in his hand and put it on the bow.
At this time, Xu Ming and Wu Xiaopang also reacted and took out their weapons.
In two short Qi refining periods, he could easily kill anyone. However, as an elder, he also has his arrogance and does not bother to take action against his disciples.
He immediately glanced behind him and said: "Keep him alive, just kill him!"
The two disciples behind him responded and greeted Xu Ming and Xu Ming with sneers, as if they were looking at two lambs waiting to be slaughtered.
What strength can a disciple who has cultivated as an elder in the foundation-building stage have? The most important thing is that Xu Ming and Wu Xiaopang both look young. They are only seventeen or eighteen years old at most. Their ability to reach the third or fourth level of Qi Refining is considered unparalleled in their eyes.
They have been practicing with Qiu Lue for more than five years, and have already reached the eighth level of Qi refining stage.
"Junior Brother Bai, leave that fat guy to you, I'll destroy this pretty boy!"
The two disciples said this and greeted Xu Ming and Xu Ming respectively.
Seeing this, Qiu Lue also looked relieved. He raised the bow in his hand and pointed the arrow at Zhang Yun again, and said with a smile: "Don't worry, Elder Qi Pa, I will spare your life. After all, I have to wait for you to pay back the bet after you get out!"
However, this arrow was dodged again, hitting the ground and creating a small crater.
Qiu Lue didn't pay attention. He looked at Zhang Yun's chaotic steps, a playful sneer on his lips, and shot out another arrow.
As a monk who is good at using a bow, he enjoys watching his enemies dodge around like prey.
Zhang Yun dodged again, his steps looking even more messy.
Qiu Lue's teasing at the corner of his mouth became more intense, and he continued to shoot with his bow.
Arrow after arrow, looking at Zhang Yun who kept dodging in confusion, Qiu Lue sneered: "It's almost time for you to see blood!"
As he spoke, his eyes condensed, and the spiritual energy on the feather arrow burst out. The speed of this arrow was obviously faster than any previous arrows.
Just when he was expecting the blood flowers to bloom on Zhang Yun's body, he found that Zhang Yun's steps were messy a second ago. This second, his feet suddenly straightened up and he actually took a mysterious step, perfectly dodging the sharp arrow.
